_meta: Hand-curated damage-relevant conditions. Auto-parsed raw conditions are noisy (engine tags), so the high-value damage conditions are curated here. Each maps to resistance/vulnerability/bonuses the engine consumes.

Wet.description: Creature is wet. Resistant to Fire, Vulnerable to Cold and Lightning.

Burning.description: On fire. Takes 1d4 Fire damage per turn (start of turn). Shares Stack ID BURNING with Melting/Holy Fire/Roiling Hellfire/Scorching Aura/Burning Fiercely, so only one applies at a time. Removed by Help action, Healing Potion, or gaining Wet. Immune while Wet. Note: BURNING stack-id does NOT stack with itself in the dice-multiplying sense — reapplication refreshes/extends duration rather than adding a second 1d4 instance (engine simplification: treat as single 1d4 Fire per turn).

damage_per_turn.note: single-instance, duration-refresh only; stack-id mutual exclusion with Melting etc.

notes: Burning creatures take DOUBLE damage from Fire Elemental's Multiattack (special interaction, not a general vulnerability).
Burning creatures take +1d4 Weapon damage from Dragon's Grasp / Firestoker.
Mutual exclusion with Melting lets a Burning creature walk in lava taking only 1d4 Fire/turn instead of 10d6 Fire/turn.

Scorching Aura.note: bonus on attacks by the aura's source, not per-turn

Blessed.description: Adds 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.

Bane.description: Subtracts 1d4 from attack rolls and saving throws.

Rage (Barbarian).description: Resistance to bludgeoning/piercing/slashing. Advantage on STR checks/saves. +rage damage on melee STR attacks.

Reverberation.description: Each remaining turn of Reverberation applies -1 penalty to STR/DEX/CON saving throws. At 5+ turns: target takes 1d4 Thunder DRS damage and must make a DC 10 CON save or fall Prone (2 turns); condition is then removed. Note: the -1 CON penalty applies to the Prone save itself, so effective DC is ~15. Thunder-immune creatures are NOT actually prevented from receiving Reverberation (bug: description claims immunity but no such mechanic exists).
bugs: Description says Thunder-immune creatures can't receive Reverberation, but no such mechanic exists.
In real-time (non-combat) mode, the 5-stack effects do not trigger, though duration is still capped at 5.

Guiding Bolt (Condition).description: Next attack roll against this creature has Advantage.

Hex.description: Marked target takes +1d6 necrotic from the caster's weapon attacks. Concentration.

Hunter's Mark Quarry.description: Marked target takes +1d6 piercing from weapon attacks. Concentration.

Lightning Charges.description: On weapon attack hit, +1d8 lightning as a new damage source (DRS). Stacks consumed on hit.

Radiating Orb.description: Target has Disadvantage on attack rolls. Stacks.

Vulnerable.description: Target takes double damage of the vulnerable type. Applied per-type via target.vulnerabilities.

Blinded.description: Can't see. Attacks against the creature have Advantage; the creature's attacks have Disadvantage.

Poisoned.description: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

Frightened.description: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks while the source of fear is in sight.

Restrained.description: Attacks against it have Advantage; its attacks have Disadvantage; Disadvantage on DEX saves.

Prone.description: Cannot move or take Actions/Bonus Actions/Reactions. Disadvantage on STR and DEX saving throws. Attacks against a Prone creature have Advantage if made within 3 m (10 ft) (melee); ranged attacks against it have Disadvantage. A Prone creature must spend half its Movement Speed to stand up. Falling Prone immediately ends Concentration. If a creature falls Prone on its own turn, the turn immediately ends. Sources: Reverberation (5 stacks, DC 10/eff ~15 CON save, 2-turn Prone), Ice surface (separate 2-turn Prone), Encrusted with Frost (does NOT cause Prone — it causes Frozen). NOTE: Prone itself deals no damage and grants no damage modifier; its damage relevance is via Advantage on melee attacks and via enabling shatter of a Frozen target (but shatter is a Frozen mechanic, not a Prone mechanic).
Prone.duration_note: 2-turn Prone is effectively 1 round (ticks down at start of affected creature's turn). Some sources (Brutal Leap, Primal Stampede, Reverberation, Throw, Ice) cannot have their Prone extended to 2 turns before it ends.
Prone.athlete_feat_stand_up_cost: 1.5 m (5 ft) instead of half movement
Prone.interaction_with_frozen: Prone and Frozen are separate conditions; knocking a Frozen target Prone does not shatter it. Shatter is triggered only by dealing Bludgeoning/Thunder/Force damage to a Frozen target.
Prone.help_action: Another creature can use the Help action to remove Prone, 'un-skipping' the prone creature's turn (Concentration is still broken).

Stunned.description: Attacks against it have Advantage; automatically fails STR and DEX saving throws.

Paralysed.description: Attacks against it have Advantage; auto-fails STR/DEX saves; melee attacks against it are critical hits.

Sleeping.description: Attacks against it have Advantage; melee attacks are critical hits; auto-fails STR/DEX saves. Wakes on damage.

Unconscious.description: Attacks against it have Advantage; melee attacks are critical hits; auto-fails STR/DEX saves.

Petrified.description: Transformed to stone. Resistant to all damage; auto-fails STR/DEX saves.

Blade Ward.description: Resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

Frozen.description: Incapacitated (cannot move/act). Grants VULNERABILITY to Bludgeoning, Thunder, and Force damage (doubles that damage — NOT an auto-crit). If dealt any Bludgeoning, Thunder, or Force damage, the ice shatters and the condition ends. Resistant to Fire. Immune to Burning and Encrusted with Frost while frozen. IMPORTANT: in-game tooltip omits the vulnerabilities; this is a known wiki-documented mechanic. NOTE: this is Vulnerability (2x damage), distinct from auto-crit (which Paralysed/Sleeping/Unconscious grant for melee).
Frozen.shatter_effect: ends Frozen condition (no separate shatter damage instance; the triggering hit just benefits from Vulnerability)

inflicted_by.note: order matters: Chilled first, then Wet. Wet-then-Chilled does NOT freeze. Re-applying Wet to an already Wet+Chilled target DOES freeze.

Frozen.duration_note: From Chilled+Wet: 1 turn (ticks down at start of frozen creature's turn, so may not disable for a full round). From Encrusted with Frost: 2 turns (effectively 1 full round).

Chilled.description: Vulnerable to Cold damage; Resistant to Fire damage. If Wet is applied to a Chilled entity, it becomes Frozen (1 turn). Order matters: Chilled-then-Wet freezes; Wet-then-Chilled does NOT freeze. Re-applying Wet to an already Wet+Chilled target DOES freeze.

freeze_rule.trigger: apply Wet to a Chilled target
freeze_rule.result: Frozen (1 turn), replacing both Chilled and Wet

Chilled.duration_note: Frozen from Chilled+Wet lasts 1 turn, ticking down at start of the frozen creature's turn — so it may end without disabling the creature for a full round. Use Encrusted with Frost (2-turn Frozen) to avoid this.

Encrusted with Frost.description: Disadvantage on DEX saving throws. At 7+ remaining turns: target must make a DC 12 CON save. On FAIL: becomes Frozen (2 turns). On SUCCESS: takes 1d4 Cold DRS damage (description claims half damage on success, but per wiki Bug: the 1d4 Cold is NOT halved). Afterward the frost is removed. Removed by Burning.

save.fixed_dc_note: Patch 7 testing: fixed DC 12 despite combat log showing variable DC (prof + spellcasting mod)

on_success.note_bug: damage is NOT halved despite description

bugs: Description claims success halves the 1d4 Cold damage; testing shows it does NOT.
Description claims success causes damage and failure causes Frozen — actually failure => Frozen, success => 1d4 Cold (unhalved).
sources: Markoheshkir (Frost of Dark Winter variant of Kereska's Favour)

Brittle.description: Vulnerable to Thunder and Bludgeoning damage. Takes 2d6 Cold damage at the start of each turn. Inflicted by Water Elemental Winter's Breath on a Burning target. (bg3.wiki raw_conditions/Brittle: description lists Thunder+Bludgeoning vulnerability; 2d6 Cold/turn.)

Electrocuted.description: Takes 1d4 Lightning damage at the start of each turn. From Electrified Water / Electrified Steam. Shares SHOCKED stack-id with Shocked. (bg3.wiki raw_conditions/Electrocuted.)
